signs: Your house. Mom says: don't forget to come home and rest!
Your rival's house. Daisy is usually home.
PALLET TOWN
Every big journey starts with one small step... and one math problem!
Practice makes perfect! Two Pidgey plus two Pidgey make four. Keep counting!
OAK POKEMON RESEARCH LAB
Great trainers check their answers twice!
ROUTE 1: PALLET TOWN - VIRIDIAN CITY
Wild Pokemon hide in the tall grass. Answer fast to catch them!
VIRIDIAN CITY
The Eternally Green Paradise. Keep growing, one problem at a time!
VIRIDIAN GYM
The Gym Leader is away... or so they say.
TRAINER SCHOOL
Learn the basics here. Practice makes perfect!
ROUTE 22 is to the west.
The road to the Pokemon League! Keep practicing, Champion-to-be!
POKEMON LEAGUE - FRONT GATE
Only trainers with all 8 badges may pass. Keep at it!
VIRIDIAN FOREST
Pewter City is just through the gate. You made it!
TRAINER TIPS
Bug Pokemon fill this forest, and they're weak to Fire. Plan your moves!
TRAINER TIPS
Can't find the way out? Every forest has one. Keep exploring!
TRAINER TIPS
Tall grass hides wild Pokemon. Quick, right answers make catching easier!
VIRIDIAN FOREST
Bug Catchers love a battle here. Keep your math sharp!
DIGGLETT'S CAVE
A long tunnel dug by Diglett. It comes out near Vermilion City!

lines: Boy: Hold it! You want to go east? Beat Brock at the Gym first!
He's tough, but you can do it. Try Water or Grass moves!

signs: PEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE
Fossils, meteorites and more. Science is just math with rocks!
PEWTER CITY GYM
Leader: Brock, the rock-solid Pokemon Trainer!
Pewter's flower garden. Count the petals... then count them again!
PEWTER CITY
A stone gray city. Solid work builds solid trainers!
ROUTE 3
Mt. Moon is just north. Rest at the Pokemon Center before you go in!
TEAM ROCKET is lurking deep in Mt. Moon. Stay sharp, and keep your math sharper!
ROUTE 4
Mt. Moon - Cerulean City. You made it through the mountain!
NUGGET BRIDGE is just north. Five trainers in a row: are you up for it?
A quiet house beside the Gym.
CERULEAN CITY GYM
Leader: Misty, the Tomboyish Mermaid!
CERULEAN CITY
A mysterious, blue aura surrounds it. So does a lot of good math!
BIKE SHOP
Bikes for the speedy trainer!
NUGGET BRIDGE
Five trainers in a row! Beat them all for a prize. Count them as you go!
SEA COTTAGE
Bill lives here. He's a Pokemon maniac, and a computer whiz!
UNDERGROUND PATH
Cerulean City - Vermilion City, under Saffron. Down the stairs here!
UNDERGROUND PATH
North: Route 5. South: Route 6. No need to count the steps... but you can!
UNDERGROUND PATH
West: Route 7. East: Route 8. A tunnel under Saffron City.
ROUTE 6
South: Vermilion City, the Port of Exquisite Sunsets!

lines: Machop: Maaa-chop! (It's stomping the ground flat for a new building.)

signs: VERMILION CITY
The Port of Exquisite Sunsets. Every problem has an answer, like every port has a ship!
POKEMON FAN CLUB
All Pokemon fans welcome! Come in and share a story.
VERMILION HARBOR
Ships to far-off places. Show your ticket at the door!
VERMILION CITY GYM
Leader: Lt. Surge, the Lightning American!
S.S. ANNE
Welcome aboard! The captain's cabin is up on the top deck.
DIGLETT'S CAVE
A long tunnel dug by Diglett. It comes out on Route 2!
ROUTE 9
East to Rock Tunnel. Bring Flash, or you'll be counting steps in the dark!
ROCK TUNNEL
A dark cave! Flash lights the way. Rest at the Pokemon Center first.
POWER PLANT
Kanto's power, made right here. Something's wrong with the generator...
ROUTE 10
Lavender Town is just south. You made it through the dark!
ROCK TUNNEL
It's pitch black in here! Flash would light it up.
Daylight ahead! Lavender Town is south on Route 10.

locked.radio: The Radio Tower is dark. The power's out!

signs: LAVENDER TOWN
The Noble Purple Town. Even quiet places hold big answers!
POKEMON TOWER
A resting place for Pokemon. Please be respectful.
LAVENDER RADIO TOWER
Off the air! The power's out...
A quiet purple house. Lavender's homes are all this color.
Lavender's garden. Count the petals, then count them again!
POKEMON TOWER
Here rest the Pokemon who have passed on. Please be quiet.
ROUTE 8
West: the Underground Path goes under Saffron to Route 7 and Celadon City.
UNDERGROUND PATH
Celadon City - Lavender Town, under Saffron. Down the stairs here!

locked.hotel: Celadon Hotel: Sorry, we're all booked up tonight!

signs: CELADON CONDOMINIUMS
Quiet homes, right in the city.
CELADON DEPT. STORE
Everything a trainer needs, on every floor!
CELADON CITY
The City of Rainbow Dreams. Dream big, and count every step!
GAME CORNER
The playground for grown-ups... and math whizzes!
CELADON HOTEL
Just past the pond. Route 16 is west, Cycling Road that way too!
CELADON CITY GYM
Leader: Erika, the Nature-Loving Princess!
ROUTE 12
North: Lavender Town. The lane to Route 11 is further south.
A huge Pokemon is sleeping on the road! A gentle tune might wake it...
ROUTE 13
Trainers, watch your step... and your sums!
Look to the left: there's always another way through the fences.
ROUTE 14
South to Route 15, then west to Fuchsia City.
ROUTE 15
West: Fuchsia City, home of the Safari Zone!
CYCLING ROAD
Bicycles only! It's a long, fast ride down to Route 18.
ROUTE 16
East: Celadon City. West: a quiet house, for those who look.
CYCLING ROAD
Keep your speed steady, like counting by fives: 5, 10, 15, 20!
ROUTE 18
East: Fuchsia City. North: Cycling Road (bike riders only).
SAFARI ZONE
Catch rare Pokemon in the wild! Gardens out front, adventure inside.
FUCHSIA CITY
Behold! It's passion pink! Keep your sums just as bright.
Behind this house is a pond. The Fishing Guru's brother lives here!
FUCHSIA CITY GYM
Leader: Koga, the Poisonous Ninja Master!

locked.house: A rest house. Nobody's resting right now.

signs: NORTH AREA
Rest here if your feet are tired!
This way: the North Area's far side.
EAST AREA
Watch for the steps up the plateaus.
WEST AREA
Someone dropped something around here...
The path bends on. Keep counting your steps!
CENTER AREA
A rest house. Catch your breath.
SAFARI ZONE
Four areas: Center, East, North and West. Each has its own Pokemon!
ROUTE 19
Sea route to Seafoam Islands and Cinnabar Island. Surf safely!
SEAFOAM ISLANDS
Two islands, one icy cave. Something cold lives deep inside...
ROUTE 21
North: Pallet Town. South: Cinnabar Island. It's a long swim!
Boulders block the way down. Strength, and a sharp mind, can move them!
The water runs fast here. Surf with care!
Something very cold is close by...
POKEMON MANSION
An old mansion. Nobody has lived here for years...
CINNABAR ISLAND GYM
Leader: Blaine, the Hotheaded Quiz Master!
POKEMON LAB
Fossils brought back to life here!
FIGHTING DOJO
Masters of fighting moves train here. Think fast, hit hard!
SAFFRON CITY GYM
Leader: Sabrina, the Master of Psychic Pokemon!
MAGNET TRAIN STATION
The fastest way to Goldenrod City in Johto!
SILPH CO.
Home of the Silph Scope, Poke Balls... and many good ideas!
SAFFRON CITY
Shining, golden land of commerce. Where every number counts!
POWER PLANT
Danger! High voltage! Electric Pokemon have moved in.
VICTORY ROAD
The last test before the Pokemon League.
ROUTE 23
The path beside the hill is quieter. Mind the rocks!
ROUTE 23
Victory Road is ahead. Only trainers with all eight badges may pass!

locked.johto: The ride to Johto is for Champions only. Beat the Elite Four first!
